narration:0:1611031001:0.text: After getting your discreet message, Zorya meets you in the lounge.
narration:0:1611031001:0.source_cn: 接到你用特殊方式传递的消息之后，佐尔娅再次来到休息室中。
narration:0:1611031001:0.male: After getting your discreet message, Zorya meets you in the lounge.
narration:0:1611031001:0.female: After getting your discreet message, Zorya meets you in the lounge.

say:2:1611031002:0.text: Merlin. You contacted me. What did you find?
say:2:1611031002:0.source_cn: 梅林，你传信给我，有什么发现？
say:2:1611031002:0.male: Merlin. You contacted me. What did you find?
say:2:1611031002:0.female: Merlin. You contacted me. What did you find?

choice_prompt:3:1611031002.text: Merlin. You contacted me. What did you find?
choice_prompt:3:1611031002.source_cn: 梅林，你传信给我，有什么发现？
choice_prompt:3:1611031002.male: Merlin. You contacted me. What did you find?
choice_prompt:3:1611031002.female: Merlin. You contacted me. What did you find?

say:4:1611031003:0.text: So, whether it was about a magical contract or the selection exam, the headmaster's death leads straight back to the Adamant Syndicate.
say:4:1611031003:0.source_cn: 无论起因是魔力契约还是选拔赛，校长死亡都与黑金商会脱不...
say:4:1611031003:0.male: So, whether it was about a magical contract or the selection exam, the headmaster's death leads straight back to the Adamant Syndicate.
say:4:1611031003:0.female: So, whether it was about a magical contract or the selection exam, the headmaster's death leads straight back to the Adamant Syndicate.

say:5:1611031004:0.text: But I never imagined the Chief Court Mage himself was involved... a man the royal family trusts implicitly.
say:5:1611031004:0.source_cn: 但我没想到，深受王室信任的首席魔法师居然暗藏祸心。
say:5:1611031004:0.male: But I never imagined the Chief Court Mage himself was involved... a man the royal family trusts implicitly.
say:5:1611031004:0.female: But I never imagined the Chief Court Mage himself was involved... a man the royal family trusts implicitly.

say:6:1611031005:0.text: His ties to the Syndicate must run even deeper than we thought.
say:6:1611031005:0.source_cn: 他与黑金商会的关系，恐怕比我们所知的还要深。
say:6:1611031005:0.male: His ties to the Syndicate must run even deeper than we thought.
say:6:1611031005:0.female: His ties to the Syndicate must run even deeper than we thought.

say:7:1611031006:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate, Gervan, Cyran... they've likely been in collusion for some time.
say:7:1611031006:0.source_cn: 黑金商会，格墨文，迪尔格雷，他们三方应该早有勾结。
say:7:1611031006:0.male: The Adamant Syndicate, Gervan, Cyran... they've likely been in collusion for some time.
say:7:1611031006:0.female: The Adamant Syndicate, Gervan, Cyran... they've likely been in collusion for some time.

say:8:1611031007:0.text: Once their plan succeeded, Gervan would take a seat among the court mages, Cyran would gain access to the Arcane Council's classified archives, and through them, the Syndicate would learn everything we've been protecting.
say:8:1611031007:0.source_cn: 阴谋得逞，格墨文成为宫廷魔法师，迪尔格雷获得魔法师协会...
say:8:1611031007:0.male: Once their plan succeeded, Gervan would take a seat among the court mages, Cyran would gain access to the Arcane Council's classified archives, and through them, the Syndicate would learn everything we've been protecting.
say:8:1611031007:0.female: Once their plan succeeded, Gervan would take a seat among the court mages, Cyran would gain access to the Arcane Council's classified archives, and through them, the Syndicate would learn everything we've been protecting.

say:9:1611031008:0.text: Unless we have solid proof, we can't rush to accuse Gervan or Cyran. They're firmly entrenched in the nobility and the court—neither of us could topple them lightly.
say:9:1611031008:0.source_cn: 不过，除非有确切的证据，否则我们不能贸然对格墨文和迪尔...
say:9:1611031008:0.male: Unless we have solid proof, we can't rush to accuse Gervan or Cyran. They're firmly entrenched in the nobility and the court—neither of us could topple them lightly.
say:9:1611031008:0.female: Unless we have solid proof, we can't rush to accuse Gervan or Cyran. They're firmly entrenched in the nobility and the court—neither of us could topple them lightly.

say:10:1611031009:0.text: We have the broad strokes, but we're still missing details.
say:10:1611031009:0.source_cn: 事情大体上已经清楚，但仍有细节需要补充。
say:10:1611031009:0.male: We have the broad strokes, but we're still missing details.
say:10:1611031009:0.female: We have the broad strokes, but we're still missing details.

say:11:1611031010:0.text: Our enemies are hiding in the shadows, watching our every move.
say:11:1611031010:0.source_cn: 我们的敌人，始终藏在暗处，对我们虎视眈眈。
say:11:1611031010:0.male: Our enemies are hiding in the shadows, watching our every move.
say:11:1611031010:0.female: Our enemies are hiding in the shadows, watching our every move.

say:12:1611031011:0.text: If they succeed, our secrets will be exposed, and every one of us will become a target.
say:12:1611031011:0.source_cn: 阴谋如果得逞，魔法师协会信息泄露，我们会成为黑暗爪牙的...
say:12:1611031011:0.male: If they succeed, our secrets will be exposed, and every one of us will become a target.
say:12:1611031011:0.female: If they succeed, our secrets will be exposed, and every one of us will become a target.

choice_prompt:13:1611031011.text: If they succeed, our secrets will be exposed, and every one of us will become a target.
choice_prompt:13:1611031011.source_cn: 阴谋如果得逞，魔法师协会信息泄露，我们会成为黑暗爪牙的狩猎目标。
choice_prompt:13:1611031011.male: If they succeed, our secrets will be exposed, and every one of us will become a target.
choice_prompt:13:1611031011.female: If they succeed, our secrets will be exposed, and every one of us will become a target.

say:14:1611031012:0.text: Don't underestimate them. The Syndicate doesn't give up easily.
say:14:1611031012:0.source_cn: 不要掉以轻心，黑金商会很难缠。
say:14:1611031012:0.male: Don't underestimate them. The Syndicate doesn't give up easily.
say:14:1611031012:0.female: Don't underestimate them. The Syndicate doesn't give up easily.

say:15:1611031013:0.text: But no matter what, our secrets <style="highlight">cannot</style> fall into their hands.
say:15:1611031013:0.source_cn: 但无论发生什么，协会的信息<style=highlig...
say:15:1611031013:0.male: But no matter what, our secrets <style="highlight">cannot</style> fall into their hands.
say:15:1611031013:0.female: But no matter what, our secrets <style="highlight">cannot</style> fall into their hands.

say:16:1611031014:0.text: If it comes down to it, destroying that Memory Star they're after is better than letting it fall into their hands.
say:16:1611031014:0.source_cn: 关键时刻，毁掉那枚对方在寻找的记忆之星，比让它落入对方...
say:16:1611031014:0.male: If it comes down to it, destroying that Memory Star they're after is better than letting it fall into their hands.
say:16:1611031014:0.female: If it comes down to it, destroying that Memory Star they're after is better than letting it fall into their hands.

say:17:1611031015:0.text: I trust you'll make the right call, First Seat.
say:17:1611031015:0.source_cn: 首席，我相信你会做出最合适的选择。
say:17:1611031015:0.male: I trust you'll make the right call, First Seat.
say:17:1611031015:0.female: I trust you'll make the right call, First Seat.

say:19:1611031016:0.text: You feel the immense weight of the Council's secrets. The title of "Magister Supreme" has never felt heavier.
say:19:1611031016:0.source_cn: 你深知魔法师协会的绝密信息意味着什么。身为首席，此刻你...
say:19:1611031016:0.male: You feel the immense weight of the Council's secrets. The title of "Magister Supreme" has never felt heavier.
say:19:1611031016:0.female: You feel the immense weight of the Council's secrets. The title of "Magister Supreme" has never felt heavier.

say:20:1611031017:0.text: It's true—you've lost your powers, your memories, even the people who once stood beside you.
say:20:1611031017:0.source_cn: 是的，你遗忘了过去，忘掉了很多事，很多人，很多本领。
say:20:1611031017:0.male: It's true—you've lost your powers, your memories, even the people who once stood beside you.
say:20:1611031017:0.female: It's true—you've lost your powers, your memories, even the people who once stood beside you.

say:21:1611031018:0.text: But something inside you has always remained. A quiet pull, a guiding voice, leading you back to who you truly are.
say:21:1611031018:0.source_cn: 但自始至终，你都知道心底始终有什么东西一直在引导你，呼...
say:21:1611031018:0.male: But something inside you has always remained. A quiet pull, a guiding voice, leading you back to who you truly are.
say:21:1611031018:0.female: But something inside you has always remained. A quiet pull, a guiding voice, leading you back to who you truly are.

narration:22:1611031019:0.text: Zorya leaves, and you're left alone with your thoughts. Sleep eventually claims you.
narration:22:1611031019:0.source_cn: 佐尔娅离开了，你在满头思绪中入睡
narration:22:1611031019:0.male: Zorya leaves, and you're left alone with your thoughts. Sleep eventually claims you.
narration:22:1611031019:0.female: Zorya leaves, and you're left alone with your thoughts. Sleep eventually claims you.

narration:23:1611031020:0.text: Before long, dawn breaks on a new day.
narration:23:1611031020:0.source_cn: 很快，新一天的太阳又升起了

choice:13:1:2.text: I'll find a way to stop this.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 我会想办法阻止这一切
choice:13:1:2.male: I'll find a way to stop this.
choice:13:1:2.female: I'll find a way to stop this.

choice:3:2:3.text: The conspiracy is aimed at the Arcane Council.
choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 这次阴谋目的指向魔法师协会
choice:3:2:3.male: The conspiracy is aimed at the Arcane Council.
choice:3:2:3.female: The conspiracy is aimed at the Arcane Council.
